name: Modern Energy
old_description: We would like to extend our heartfelt gratitude to all of our past clients for your trust and support over the years. Due to the lasting impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic, Modern Energy made the difficult decision to discontinue operations in 2021. While we are no longer able to offer our services to past or new clients, we are deeply proud of the work we accomplished together and sincerely thank you for being a part of our journey. It has been a privilege to serve you.
about:
Modern Energy was a solar panel installation company based in Dublin, Ohio. The company did not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founders. In 2021, citing the lasting impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic, Modern Energy announced via its website that it would discontinue operations and would no longer offer services to past or new clients.

The company specialized in the installation of solar photovoltaic systems for residential and commercial clients. Details regarding the scale of its operations, such as facility size, employee count, or annual installation volume, were not publicly disclosed. The company's online presence identified it as an 'Ohio Solar Panel Installer,' indicating a regional focus within the state.

Modern Energy served property owners seeking solar energy solutions, though specific industry sectors or notable client examples were not documented in available sources. The closure notice thanked 'all of our past clients for your trust and support over the years,' suggesting a base of residential and possibly commercial customers in the Ohio area.

The company did not publicly articulate a specific founding mission or competitive differentiation beyond its installation services. Its final communication emphasized pride in the work accomplished together with clients and described the service as a privilege.
